Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Sandevistan Operating System. The Sandevistan counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss, and a non-FBC user without a Cyberspine takes 1d6 Humanity Loss every time they activate it. It can be activated without an Action, its initiative bonus rises by 1 to +4, and it lasts 9 seconds (3 Rounds). While active the user can dodge Ranged Attacks whatever their REF, if they couldn't already. At the start of each of their Turns while it is active they choose either +2 MOVE until the end of that Turn, or +4 on a single Evasion check made before the start of their next Turn. It can't be activated again for an hour unless the user takes 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation inside that hour.

Foundry notes:

  • Change the Sandevistan's initiative effect to +4 while this OS is installed.
  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Sandevistan Operating Systems).
